title: Meadowbrook school campus
goal: Show campus buildings, parking, play space, and fire access.

rubric.must: Administration, Primary Building, Gymnasium, and Middle School are visibly separate labelled footprints.
Staff Parking and Play Fields are visibly labelled areas.
A continuous labelled fire access route visibly serves the academic buildings.
School Drive and the main entry are visibly connected to the campus circulation.
Hydrant, north arrow, scale, and legend are visible.
